g.text: Nearby — Code Structure: the import process (CMP-03), src/import/ with core/import and ImportInfraModule
The providers are injected as one array
Connects as nearby_import, with no key files.
Clock is bound to the system time (no class).
Solid arrow: calls (constructor injection; from ImportAppModule: loads)
ESLint rejects any other import across these boxes
Implementations have the methods of the abstract class they implement
Grey boxes: shown on code-structure-core-operations and code-structure-infra
